CSP notes
---------
Leaflet only uses innerHTML with its own constant markup, the layer names and
attribution strings passed by atlas-core.js (constants, not data), and
tooltip/popup content given as a string. The explorer and site maps always
pass DOM nodes as tooltip content, so no dataset value reaches innerHTML.
Inline positioning is done through element.style (CSSOM), which the
style-src 'self' policy allows.

Basemaps used with it (checked 2026-10-09, HTTP status only)
-------------------------------------------------------------
- CARTO light_all / dark_all, https://{a-d}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/...{r}.png:
  200 (incl. @2x, up to z20). Attribution: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors
  (c) CARTO, linked to https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright and
  https://carto.com/attributions
- OpenStreetMap, https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png: 200 up to
  z19 (z20 returns 400). Attribution: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, linked
  to https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
- EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless, WMTS capabilities
  https://tiles.maps.eox.at/wmts/1.0.0/WMTSCapabilities.xml (200). Newest
  3857 layer: s2cloudless-2025_3857, tile matrix sets g / GoogleMapsCompatible
  (levels 0-21, no per-layer limits); tiles return 200 up to z18 and 404 from
  z19, so maxNativeZoom is 18. Attribution, in EOX's own wording from the
  layer abstract: "EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services
  GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025)", licence CC BY-NC-SA
  4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/; every layer from
  2018 on). The 2016/2017 layers are CC BY 4.0.
